findings.title: Incorrect argument order in URLSafeTimedSerializer call
findings.body: The new code passes `keys` as the second positional argument to `URLSafeTimedSerializer`, but the class expects the secret key as the first argument. This will cause a runtime error when the serializer is used. The `keys` parameter should be passed as a keyword argument instead.
findings.suggestion:
app.secret_key,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            keys=keys,  # type: ignore[arg-type]

findings.title: Inconsistent indentation in signer_kwargs dictionary
findings.body: The `signer_kwargs` dictionary is defined with inconsistent indentation (4 spaces for the opening brace, 12 spaces for the contents). This breaks the local convention of consistent indentation within the same block. The indentation should be uniform (4 spaces per level).

summary.problem: The session serializer change introduces a critical correctness issue and a readability inconsistency.
summary.done_well: The new code implements secret key rotation with fallback keys, which aligns with the PR's intent to enable key rotation.
